# FreeGSNKE integration

FreeGSNKE is used as prior-art physics infrastructure. This project does not
claim its solver, machine configurations, growth-rate method, or examples as a
new contribution.

The first integration executes a pinned upstream notebook prefix through the
first coupled plasma/metal linearisation, then exports the native matrices with
hash-linked provenance. A passing run raises the artifact only to a
**machine-derived public MAST-U-like configuration** result. It is not an
experimental MAST-U validation and not a reactor prediction.
